attributes.why_unmapped: This master qualification applies across all Company representations via SEC filings and cross-referenced disclosure letter items; it is not a clause-level accuracy or knowledge standard and cannot be expressed by the controlled vocabularies in this slice.
attributes.observed_category: SEC-filings and disclosure-letter carve-out governing the entire representations section

claim.raw_value: “Company Material Adverse Effect” means any event, change, effect, development, circumstance, state of facts, condition or occurrence (each, an “Effect”) that, when considered individually or in the aggregate with all other Effects, is or would reasonably be expected to have a material adverse effect on the business, condition (financial or otherwise) or results of operations of the Company and its Subsidiaries, taken as a whole; provided that no change or development resulting from or arising out of any of the following, alone or in combination, shall be deemed to constitute or be taken into account in determining whether there has been a Company Material Adverse Effect

attributes.why_unmapped: Defines the threshold concept referenced by the THRESHOLD qualifiers throughout this section; the enumerated carve-out taxonomy (disproportionate industry effect, announcement effects, required actions, litigation, law/GAAP changes, projection/stock-price misses) is not expressible as a single accuracy or knowledge code.
attributes.observed_category: Defined-term materiality scrape (Company Material Adverse Effect) with enumerated (A)-(J) carve-outs

claim.raw_value: The term “Knowledge,” when used in this Agreement (i) with respect to the Company, shall mean the actual knowledge of those persons set forth in Section ‎3.1(g)(iii) of the Company Disclosure Letter after due inquiry of such person’s direct reports and (ii) with respect to Parent shall mean the actual knowledge of those persons set forth in Section ‎3.1(g)(iii) of the Parent Disclosure Letter after due inquiry of such person’s direct reports.

attributes.why_unmapped: This is the interpretive definition establishing that 'Knowledge of the Company' throughout the section means actual knowledge of named persons after due inquiry of their direct reports; it is a defined-term clause, not a representation limb, so it is recorded here rather than as its own representation_instances object, though it is the basis for the AFTER_INQUIRY coding used elsewhere.
attributes.observed_category: Defined-term establishing the Knowledge standard applied throughout the section
